_comment: Copy to config.json (scripts/install-pi.sh does this for you). Every key is optional; LABHUB_<KEY> env vars override. github_repo is the repo whose github_branch holds board.json: normally the code repo lab-hub itself (branch data). A separate data repo also works (README: optional hardening). pages_url empty = derived from the git origin (https://<owner>.github.io/<repo>/). Keep host/port here, not in /etc/default/lab-hub. Prefer the LABHUB_GITHUB_TOKEN env var (or install-pi.sh, which chmods config.json to 600) over typing the token here. See README.md > Configuration.
name: Lab Hub
